description: ANAS Strade Statali is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ANSFISA - Agenzia Nazionale per la Sicurezza delle Ferrovie e delle Infrastrutture Stradali e Autostradali. La rete viaria di interesse nazionale gestita da ANAS comprende oggi oltre 27.000 km di strade. Coverage: Italy. The portal files it under the publisher ANSFISA - Agenzia Nazionale per la Sicurezza delle Ferrovie e delle Infrastrutture Stradali e Autostradali. Its tags are autostrade, strade. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-05-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
